name: Deus Ex
description: Deus Ex is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person action role-playing and immersive sim game and the first in the Deus Ex series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Deus Ex ships with its hardware sound option off, and it only plays EAX reverb with it on.

audio_settings.title: Enable Dolby Pro Logic
audio_settings.reason: Turns on Dolby Pro Logic, A compatible AV receiver or Soundbar is required for Surround sound. Dolby Pro Logic is an analog matrix surround-sound codec technology.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex mixes its sound at a lower rate than most sound systems play at, so it's resampled before you hear it.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: Deus Ex runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

sources.title: Kcat - Dsoal - Deus Ex No reverb

notes: Reverb is quiet by default, so the install offers to boost it. Stay on the default Galaxy driver: the community ALAudio mod doesn't pass the game's EAX reverb through.
